text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Rightist parties call for national mobilisation to register on electoral lists.
- Morocco hosts three-day congress on ways to protect environment in the Mediterranean.
- Finance ministry backtracks on commitments to apply internal promotion as decided by August social accord.
- Foreign ministers of French-speaking countries to hold annual meeting in Marrakesh starting Dec 17.
- Crisis with the European Union looms after Fisheries Minister Mustapha Sahel said that fish accord would not be renewed.
- Privatisation Minister Abderrahmam Saaidi backs project to split activity of the telecommunications utility amid union protests.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj says that economic growth depends on agriculture but with cereal liberalisation massive imports were detrimental to local producers.
